name: Tear of Tilloa
summary: Near Darkshire, the Tear of Tilloa draws those seeking rare alchemical reagents. The flower grows on the Mistmantle estate in Duskwood.

sections.title: A Garden in the Gloom
sections.body: Outside Darkshire, the Tear of Tilloa grows on Stalvan Mistmantle’s estate. Duskwood’s soil has turned hostile to wholesome vegetation, yet the small white flower persists among the shadowed plots. Rare and secluded, it draws those seeking uncommon reagents beyond lawful markets.

sections.title: A Concoction for the Nobles
sections.body: Beneath Stormwind’s streets, Zardeth of the Black Claw seeks the Tear of Tilloa for a draught meant for Lord Wishock. A member of the House of Nobles, Wishock threatens to investigate shadowy operations beneath the capital. Zardeth combines the flower with Musquash Root from beneath the Stonewrought Dam. The brew is meant to distract and incapacitate Wishock before an official probe can begin.

faq.q: Where does the Tear of Tilloa grow?
faq.answer: The flower grows in the overgrown garden of the Mistmantle family estate on the outskirts of Darkshire in Duskwood.

faq.q: Who wants the Tear of Tilloa?
faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw seeks the flower while working covertly beneath Stormwind City. He needs it for a special draught.

faq.q: What is the flower used for?
aliases: what does tear of tilloa do
faq.answer: The flower combines with Musquash Root in a brew meant to incapacitate Lord Wishock and silence his calls to investigate dark dealings beneath the capital.
Lord Wishock is a nobleman in Stormwind’s House of Nobles. After learning of subversive operations beneath the city, he began urging the council to investigate.

angles.text: As a herbalist, you may find the Tear of Tilloa in Duskwood’s blighted ground, far from the usual lush fields.
As a warlock, you may know the Tear of Tilloa as a reagent sought by occult operatives beneath the capital. They use it in brews meant to silence probing nobles.
